role: engine-neutral executable projection of one circulating Card attempt with remaining resource budget

identity.run_ref: sha256(card_ref + semantic_generation + attempt_ref + tool_name + kind + subject)

invariants: the same Card attempt and capability mapping yields the same institutional run identity on every engine
a new Heartime beat for the same attempt does not redefine run_ref
each re-emission beat gets a distinct deterministic resume request id
remaining energy and monetary cost are projected to every engine Setting without changing run_ref
runtime-local invocation identifiers are provenance only
the execution slice contains no raw tool input or output
the adapter must validate the slice seal and exact capability mapping before execution
a completed institutional run cannot produce a second external effect
a duplicate delivery of the same admitted beat fails closed

resource_projection.source: Card energy/cost authorization minus Heartime-admitted consumption
resource_projection.identity_effect: resource budget is sealed execution context but is excluded from institutional run identity
